title: Announcement of Overtime
text:
Announcement of Overtime
According to the Overtime Procedure of Factory and General Labour Laws
Inspection Department, it is hereby announced that companies which are
investing under Myanmar Investment Commission (MIC) and Region/State
Investment Committee’s permit and endorsement shall carry out the following.
- Companies shall seek signed approval from an employee required to work
overtime on a weekday (Monday to Friday) which is not to exceed 3 hours
per weekday or 5 hours on a Saturday.
- For overtime on a Sunday or a Public Holiday, companies shall seek signed
approval from the employee and an acknowledgement from the
Workplace Coordination Committee.
- No employee may be required to work more than one Sunday in a 4 week
period.
Myanmar Investment Commission
